unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to classify epidemiological characteristics in social media posts for public health surveillance
Validating LLM classifications against human experts and other LLMs

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the capability of several LLMs (e.g., GPT-4, Mixtral 8x22b) to classify epidemiological characteristics of conjunctivitis outbreaks from synthetic and real-world social media posts compared to human experts. It does not evaluate a specific operational deployment practice or safeguard.
